journey.title: Explore reverse splits
journey.detail: Earlier studies examined split magnitude and repeated actions. A large split ratio alone was not treated as a proven short signal.

journey.title: Freeze the third-plus cohort
journey.detail: Count documented distinct prior actions by SEC issuer. Use only history known before the decision.

journey.title: Save the rally veto
journey.detail: Exclude any single adjusted daily close-to-close rise of at least 50% in the five completed sessions before entry. Unknown history is excluded.

journey.title: Reconcile the filings
journey.detail: Recover original contexts, total operating cash flow and comparable share units. Exact dilution for 209 events; one proven threshold bound.

journey.title: Compare fixed additions
journey.detail: 254 model definitions; 225 unique replays. Keep account rules, clocks and costs comparable.

journey.title: Check what survives
journey.detail: Require uncertainty, concentration, chronology, costs and exit obligations to pass. The highest historical profit is not an established optimum.

feature_rules.reported_runway: Reported cash / negative TTM CFO <0.5 years; not financing-adjusted
feature_rules.dilution: Split-adjusted common-share growth >=25% over 150–240 days; proven bounds retained as bounds
feature_rules.margin8: TTM operating-margin YoY change <=-8 percentage points
feature_rules.accrual10: (TTM NI - TTM CFO) / average exact current and year-ago assets >=10%; no last-asset fallback
feature_rules.profit_no_cash: TTM NI>0 and TTM total CFO<0
feature_rules.debt_distress: Dated operating profile, negative total CFO, TTM and reconstructed-quarter reported runways <=1 year, operating loss, explicit next-12-month debt maturity>cash
feature_rules.legacy_score60: Unmodified prior source-bound score>=60; diagnostic comparator, not a rebuilt score
